measure: Exact quantiles of supplied normalized finite atomic quadrature/particle distribution; no prior-bin spreading

prior_control.meaning: Exact .95 unconditional prior interval for the frozen two-branch family

material_scope: A position interval may include the unsupported gap between two target intervals; intermediate Bayes position is not a legal additional material world.
